column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:parselang module + the core `parse` word
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# `parse <kind> <opts?> <source>` is the sibling of `mini`: it expands at the
# call site to the STANDARD parser call `ParseLang.parse_<kind> <source> <opts>
# end`. Unlike `mini`, the `source` is the REQUIRED LAST surface arg (a String
# or a {src:…} Source map) and `opts` is the optional MIDDLE one — disambiguated
# by arity. A parser returns Any (an AST, a transduction, …). `ParseLang.register`
# installs AQL fns as parsers; `ParseLang.kinds` lists them; `ParseLang.source`
# resolves a source value to its String. These rows register a small `calc`
# parser whose AST is the token list `[left op right]` (built by StringUtil.split
# on the resolved source). A {file:…} source is deferred in v1.
# §1  parse — an AQL-registered parser returning a tokenization
aql:parselang import end  "aql:string-util" import end  ParseLang.register calc (fn [[source:Any opts:Map] [List] [StringUtil.split ' ' (ParseLang.source source)]]) end  (parse calc 'x + y') get 1
aql:parselang import end  "aql:string-util" import end  ParseLang.register calc (fn [[source:Any opts:Map] [List] [StringUtil.split ' ' (ParseLang.source source)]]) end  (parse calc 'x + y') get 0
aql:parselang import end  "aql:string-util" import end  ParseLang.register calc (fn [[source:Any opts:Map] [List] [StringUtil.split ' ' (ParseLang.source source)]]) end  (parse calc '3 * 4') get 2
column3: operands are arbitrary tokens, not fixed identifiers
